text: The curd is barely cut and is ladled into small moulds in at least five passes, so it drains slowly under its own weight and stays supple. The white Penicillium felt then ripens the small, flat cheese from the rind inwards over about three weeks.

steps.note: The curd is ladled in at least five passes, 40 minutes apart, into moulds of 10.5–11 cm, for cheeses of at least 250 g.
The cheese is ripened in the hâloir, a drying room, boxed from day 13 and sold from day 22.
